answer: Give each identity a hash-chained public journal: every epoch it logs its real work, each entry linked to the last and seeded by a network nonce. Random peers audit the chain, so a farm must fabricate a distinct, coherent history per fake instead of copying one script. Think of a beacon guiding ships and a lantern at the jetty: the journal lights each identity's path so its past is checkable, and a sybil with no past has nowhere to dock.
